questions.question: My store's permit expires this year. How do I get it renewed?
questions.reply:
Requirements for a NEW business permit (BPLO checklist):
1. Barangay Business Clearance — from the barangay where your business is located
2. Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
3. Business registration:
   • DTI — single proprietorship (for example, a sari-sari store)
   • SEC — corporation
   • CDA — cooperative
Local clearances:
4. Block tiendas, public market occupants and water refilling stations: go to the MEEDMO
5. Sanitary Permit / Health Certificate
6. Zoning Clearance
7. Assessor's Clearance
8. Municipal Engineering Office clearance
9. Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) clearance
10. MENRO Certification
You can ask me how much it costs, how long it takes, or where to apply.

questions.question: My wife just gave birth last week. How do we register our baby?
questions.reply:
Need a copy of a birth certificate that is already registered? A PSA copy costs ₱155 at a PSA outlet or about ₱330 online at https://www.psaserbilis.com.ph; a local certified copy comes from the Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO) at the Municipal Hall.

To register a birth — a newborn's or a late registration — the LCRO uses one checklist:

LATE REGISTRATION OF BIRTH CERTIFICATE
CHECKLIST OF REQUIREMENTS

1. Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) Negative Result
2. National ID (1 yr old and above)
3. 2x2 size picture w/ white background (unedited front-facing photo)
4. Affidavit of Two (2) Disinterested Persons
5. Any two (2) of the following documents evidence which may show the name of the child:
   a. Baptismal Certificate
   b. School Records
   c. Income Tax Return
   d. Medical Records, Immunization record
   e. Voter Registration Record (VRR)
   f. Philhealth (MDR)
6. Valid ID of Informant, Senior Citizen ID
7. Marriage Certificate of document owner, if applicable
8. Siblings birth certificate, if applicable
9. Any two (2) documents evidences showing of the identity of parents:
   a. Certificate of Live Birth of Parents
   b. Government issued ID
   c. Marriage Cert. of Parents
   d. Death Cert. of Parents
10. Barangay Certification as proof of residency
11. Affidavit of Acknowledgment, Affidavit of Admission of Paternity, Affidavit to use the surname of the father, and Certificate of Registration (for illegitimate child), if applicable

questions.question: My grandfather passed away yesterday. What do we need to do to register his death?
questions.reply: To register a death, go to the Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO) at the Municipal Hall within 30 days. Bring the Certificate of Death (Municipal Form 103), filled out and signed by the attending physician — or, if no doctor attended, examined and signed by the Municipal Health Officer — and a valid ID of the informant. Once the death is registered, the burial permit is issued (Sanitation Code, PD 856); a transfer permit is needed if the burial is in another town. Ask me "how much is a death certificate?" for the fee.

questions.question: Can you explain what the YAKAP program offers to residents?
questions.reply:
YAKAP (Yaman ng Kalusugan Program) is PhilHealth's primary care package, offered at the Magallanes Rural Health Unit. Registered members get:
• Check-ups with health education, and services to prevent illness
• Referral to a hospital when needed
• Free laboratory tests such as CBC, cholesterol, blood sugar, chest X-ray, ECG, urinalysis and pap smear (some at a diagnostic center, with a referral)
• Screening such as mammogram, breast and liver ultrasound, low-dose chest CT scan and colonoscopy
• Medicines, up to a ₱20,000 budget
Coverage runs from January to December 31, and you register again each year. To register you need PhilHealth and a valid ID.
You can ask me about the requirements, the medicines, the lab tests or the screening.

questions.question: what health services can I avail under PhilHealth YAKAP
questions.reply:
To register for YAKAP at the Municipal Health Office (Rural Health Unit):
1. PhilHealth membership — if you don't have PhilHealth yet, get it first. An expired or unpaid PhilHealth status is usually okay, because staff look you up in the PhilHealth system.
2. A valid ID — a photocopy is enough.
3. A registration form, which you fill out at the office.

questions.question: Unsa man diay ang YAKAP nga programa sa PhilHealth?
questions.reply:
Ang YAKAP (Yaman ng Kalusugan Program) mao ang primary care package sa PhilHealth, nga anaa sa Magallanes Rural Health Unit. Ang mga rehistrado makakuha og:
• Check-up uban ang health education, ug serbisyo para malikayan ang sakit
• Referral sa ospital kung kinahanglan
• Libre nga laboratory test sama sa CBC, cholesterol, blood sugar, chest X-ray, ECG, urinalysis ug pap smear (ang uban sa diagnostic center, uban ang referral)
• Screening sama sa mammogram, breast ug liver ultrasound, low-dose chest CT scan ug colonoscopy
• Tambal, hangtod ₱20,000 nga budget
Ang coverage sugod Enero hangtod Disyembre 31, ug magparehistro ka usab kada tuig. Para magparehistro, kinahanglan nimo ang PhilHealth ug valid ID.
Pwede ka mangutana bahin sa requirements, tambal, lab test, o screening.

questions.question: What's the story behind the Magellan Shrine in Magallanes?
questions.reply:
The Magellan Shrine stands in Poblacion, near the Municipal Hall, close to where the Agusan River meets Butuan Bay. The marker, erected in 1872, commemorates a Mass held on 8 April 1521 by Ferdinand Magellan's expedition — the town is named after him (Magallanes is the Spanish form of Magellan). Magallanes and Butuan have long claimed the first Catholic Mass in Mindanao, while the National Historical Commission recognises Limasawa, Southern Leyte, as the site of the first Mass in the Philippines. There is no entrance fee.

Requirements for a NEW business permit (BPLO checklist):

2. Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
3. Business registration:
   • DTI — single proprietorship (for example, a sari-sari store)
   • SEC — corporation

Local clearances:
4. Block tiendas, public market occupants and water refilling stations: go to the MEEDMO
5. Sanitary Permit / Health Certificate
6. Zoning Clearance
7. Assessor's Clearance
8. Municipal Engineering Office clearance
9. Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) clearance
10. MENRO Certification
You can ask me how much it costs, how long it takes, or where to apply.

turns.question: Unsaon namo pagparehistro sa among bata nga bag-o lang natawo?
turns.reply:
Kopya ra sa birth certificate nga narehistro na ang imong kinahanglan? Ang PSA copy ₱155 sa PSA outlet o mga ₱330 online sa https://www.psaserbilis.com.ph; ang local certified copy gikan sa Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO) sa Munisipyo.

Sa pagparehistro sa birth — bag-ong natawo man o late registration — usa ra ka checklist ang gamiton sa LCRO:
1. PSA Negative Result
2. National ID (kung 1 ka tuig pataas)
3. 2x2 nga picture nga puti ang background (dili edited, nag-atubang)
4. Affidavit of Two (2) Disinterested Persons
5. Bisan unsang duha (2) ka dokumento nga nagpakita sa ngalan sa bata (pananglitan: Baptismal Certificate, School Records, ITR, Medical/Immunization Record, Voter Registration Record, PhilHealth MDR)
6. Valid ID sa informant (o Senior Citizen ID)
7. Marriage Certificate sa tag-iya sa dokumento, kung aplikable
8. Birth certificate sa mga igsoon, kung aplikable
9. Bisan unsang duha (2) ka dokumento nga nagpamatuod sa identity sa mga ginikanan
10. Barangay Certification isip pamatuod nga diri ka nagpuyo
11. Para sa illegitimate nga anak, kung aplikable: Affidavit of Acknowledgment/Admission of Paternity, Affidavit to Use the Surname of the Father (AUSF), ug Certificate of Registration

turns.question: tagpila man?
turns.reply:
Mga bayronon sa Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO), Munisipyo:
• Marriage license: ₱500
• Death certificate: ₱50
• Pag-correct sa sayop sa birth certificate (pananglitan, sayop nga spelling sa ngalan): kasagaran ₱1,500
• Pag-correct sa sex (gender) entry: mga ₱6,000
• Kopya sa birth certificate: ang PSA copy ₱155 sa PSA outlet o mga ₱330 online; sa local certified copy, pangutana sa LCRO
Sa ubang dokumento, palihug pangutana sa LCRO.
